title: Appraisal and Settlement Service Standards, Keyturn Host Protection Plan
content:
The service standards the Keyturn Host Protection Plan publishes for valuing and settling a loss differ plan by plan. They cover how quickly an appraisal is answered, the value above which photographs alone will not settle a loss, the proportion of the marketplace's valuation at which a loss is treated as a total loss, how quickly accepted money is released, how long a fault finding takes, how long recovery is pursued, and the share of an out-of-network appraisal the host carries.

| Plan | Appraisal response, days | Photo estimate threshold, USD | Total loss threshold, percent | Payment period, days | Fault finding, business days | Recovery pursued, days | Out-of-network appraisal share, percent |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Keyturn Shield 90 Host Plan | 10 | 1500 | 70 | 15 | 10 | 90 | 50 |
| Keyturn Shield 85 Host Plan | 9 | 2000 | 72 | 12 | 9 | 120 | 40 |
| Keyturn Shield 80 Host Plan | 7 | 2500 | 75 | 10 | 7 | 150 | 30 |
| Keyturn Shield 75 Host Plan | 5 | 3500 | 78 | 7 | 5 | 180 | 20 |
| Keyturn Shield 70 Host Plan | 4 | 5000 | 80 | 5 | 4 | 210 | 10 |
| Keyturn Shield 60 Host Plan | 3 | 7500 | 82 | 3 | 3 | 270 | 0 |

### Direction of the ladder

Response and payment periods shorten as cover deepens: an appraisal is answered within 10 days on the Keyturn Shield 90 Host Plan and within 3 on the Keyturn Shield 60 Host Plan, and accepted money is released within 15 days at the top of the ladder and within 3 at the foot of it. The photo estimate threshold and the recovery period widen in the other direction, from 1500 and 90 days to 7500 and 270 days. The share of an out-of-network appraisal carried by the host falls from 50 percent on the Keyturn Shield 90 Host Plan to 0 percent on the Keyturn Shield 60 Host Plan, which carries none of it.
